nodes.label: Ottoman Supply Depot and Chain Hauling at the Shore
nodes.rationale: AI-generated painterly illustration (muted brown/grey tones, dramatic overcast sky) showing a foreground wooden warehouse stocked with sacks, barrels and crates, opening onto a shoreline where armored soldiers with helmets and spears haul a massive iron chain across the beach toward a large three-masted sailing ship flying a red flag with a white crescent moon; fortified towers are visible in the misty background. Composition reads as a military logistics/preparation scene for a siege, consistent with the project's theme of Mehmed the Conqueror's preparations before the siege of Constantinople.
